verdict.rationale: PayPal documents online card acceptance: debit and credit cards in checkout (paypal-docs-29), Expanded Checkout card fields (paypal-docs-27), and a no-code Payment Link you can share on a website, by email or by text (paypal-docs-31), so a founder could plausibly take a first card payment quickly. However, nothing documents signup-to-live onboarding time, and one community report says funds from a new seller's payments were held in a pending balance for up to 21 days (paypal-comm-8). missing for 10: documented signup/verification-to-first-live-payment timeline, hands-on evidence of going live within a day, clarity on new-account fund holds.
